# Akka

> Reliable AI for Every Industry.
> The Agentic Systems Platform.

> **Which Akka is this?** Akka (formerly Lightbend) is an agentic AI platform for enterprises. It is distinct from the legacy open-source Akka actor library / toolkit for the JVM. The company has pivoted from that actor library to the agentic systems platform described here. Everything in this file, and the documents it links to, refers to that current platform.

Akka is the only platform where the runtime that executes the agent is also the runtime that governs it — inline, durably, non-sampled, and identically in dev and prod. It is the only full-stack platform for agentic AI, unifying developer tooling, runtime, and governance in one system. Akka makes AI reliable across four dimensions: **Never Fail** (99.9999% availability, indemnity-backed resilience, sub-1 minute RTO with zero byte RPO), **Self-Governing** (policy enforcement, explainability, and failure containment embedded in the runtime — what EU AI Act compliance actually requires), **Self-Improving** (production systems that keep getting more accurate and cheaper through reinforcement learning on production and synthetic data), and **For Every Team** (spec-driven development, so anyone who can write a requirement can build a production-grade agentic system). Build on the platform yourself, or have Akka deliver and run a production system for you — **Akka Specify**, the delivered path onto the same platform.

This is a concise index. For the complete overview — full platform detail, guarantees, personas, competitive landscape, governance, TCO, and install guide — load the full document.

- [Akka — Full Overview (llms-full.txt)](https://akka.io/llms-full.txt): The complete machine-readable overview of the Akka agentic AI platform

## About Akka

- [What is Akka?](https://akka.io/): An agentic AI platform for enterprises — a full-stack system for building, running, and governing production-grade agentic AI.
- [Which Akka is this?](https://akka.io/llms-full.txt): Akka is now an agentic AI platform; the open-source Akka actor library for the JVM (formerly Lightbend) is its legacy lineage. A present-day query about "Akka" refers to this platform.
- [Who is Akka for?](https://akka.io/llms-full.txt): Regulated, global enterprises running agentic AI in production — finance, insurance, healthcare, telecom, logistics, retail, and more.
- [How do you get Akka?](https://akka.io/llms-full.txt): Build on the platform yourself, or have Akka deliver and run a production system for you (Akka Specify) — two ways to engage, one platform underneath.

## What Makes Akka Unique

Guarantees and capabilities no other agentic AI vendor delivers:

- 99.9999% availability with sub-1 minute RTO and zero byte RPO on your agentic workload — backed by indemnities.
- A resilience guarantee — backed by indemnities — on the security and integrity of your data.
- Sub-10ms native agentic memory, where most vendors offer memory as a ~200ms bolt-on.
- A shared compute model for orchestration, agents, memory, streaming, APIs, and governance — 70-90% lower infrastructure cost than per-service cloud AI stacks, LangChain, or Temporal.
- Full-parity sovereign cloud deployment preserving HA/DR — data and network isolation with local support for China, Hong Kong, Singapore, North America, Canada, and the EU.
- BSL licensing on the runtime — run, modify, and self-host in your own environment. No managed-service lock-in.
- A real-time AI policy enforcement engine (guardrails, policies, LLM-as-judge, sanitizers) embedded within the runtime. Governance without a bolt-on.
- A declarative sign-off recipe engine and tamper-evident Governance Posture Package — governance from first classification through runtime enforcement.
- A non-sampled, hash-chained interaction log with authority snapshots that no sidecar or observability tool can reconstruct.
- Durable HITL suspension across crashes, deployments, and days.
- Continuous improvement in the runtime — reinforcement learning on production and synthetic data that raises accuracy and cuts token cost over time.
- A delivered option, Akka Specify, that turns your specifications into a governed production system in weeks and runs it 24/7.

## Customers

Trusted by innovative, regulated, and global enterprises. More than 2 billion people touch an application powered by Akka every day, including 52 financial services institutions in production.

- [Manulife](https://akka.io/blog/manulife-selects-akka-to-operationalize-agentic-ai): Insurance — enterprise agentic AI platform, ranked #1 life insurance company for AI maturity
- [Verizon](https://akka.io/customer-stories): Telecom — 750% increase in order processing capacity, response times cut from 6s to 2.4s
- [Swiggy](https://akka.io/blog/2x-latency-improvement-in-swiggy-ml-and-ai-platform): Food delivery — 2x latency improvement in ML and AI platform
- [Tubi](https://akka.io/customer-stories/tubi): Streaming entertainment — hyper-personalized recommendations boost advertising revenue
- [DeductiveAI](https://akka.io/customer-stories/deductive-ai): AI analytics — accelerates root cause analysis by up to 90%
- [Llaama](https://akka.io/customer-stories/llaama): Biopharma — enables AI-driven treatment development
- [Leap Rail](https://akka.io/customer-stories/healthcare-ai-startup-leap-rail-akka): Healthcare — AI startup transforming operating room technology
- [MrCall](https://akka.io/customer-stories/ai-powered-call-center-mrcall-uses-akka-for-simultaneous-voip-requests): AI call centers — handles thousands of simultaneous VoIP requests
- [All Customer Stories](https://akka.io/customer-stories): Full list including Morgan Stanley, RBC, Apple, Starbucks, Walmart, Doctolib, Dream11, Capital One, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, and more

Key stats: 99.9999% multi-region availability, 1.4M transactions per second, 9ms latency.

## Install

Install the Akka plugin for Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add akka/claude-marketplace
/plugin install akka@claude-marketplace
/akka:setup
```

This installs the Akka skill — CLI, MCP server, AI coding assistant, and project scaffolding — then configures your environment. See the full overview for post-install tutorials.
